objetivo: Talk about future plans and intentions using going to.

memo.es: go to other places or countries

parejas.a: What are your plans for next year?
parejas.b: I’m going to travel to Canada.

parejas.a: How are you going to improve your English?
parejas.b: I’m going to practice every day.

parejas.a: Are you going to save money?
parejas.b: Yes, I’m going to save 10% of my salary.

parejas.a: What are you going to do tonight?
parejas.b: I’m going to study for my exam.

quiz.t: What are you going to ___ this summer?
“What are your plans for next year?”
quiz.h: What do you say? You’re going to travel to Canada.
o: I’m going to travel to Canada.

quiz.t: “What are you going to do tonight?”
quiz.h: What do you say? You’re going to study.
o: I’m going to study for my exam.

quiz.h: Your plan: talk a lot in English with your class.
o: What are you going to do?

o: What are you going to do?
